name: A request at the port

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: At Steamwheedle Port, Yeh'kinya gives the seeker a task that begins with the restless Vale Screechers of Feralas. He provides a bramble and asks that their spirits be captured, a request whose purpose the first words do not fully disclose. The desert harbor is only the threshold: the answer lies among the forested hills to the north.
